newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tools turnover down 2.4 pct in Q3.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tools turnover down 2.4 pct in Q3.

text.p: UK turnover of machine tools in the third quarter of 1996 fell by 2.4 percent compared with the previous quarter, the Office for National Statistics said on Thursday.
This was due to a 6.7 percent fall in export turnover combined with a 0.2 percent fall in home turnover.
Compared to the same period last year, total turnover was 1.9 percent lower.
Total orders on hand at the end of September 1996 were 7.0 percent higher than in the previous three months, but 4.6 percent lower than in September 1995.
